pages.title: Love & Loathe
pages.text: Love & Loathe is an interaction-focused addon for Touhou Little Maid. It adds Trust, Fear, Hunger, daily events, and several special relationship states. How you treat a maid over time affects her attitude, behavior, dialogue, and certain special abilities.

pages.title: Start Here
pages.text: Most features appear naturally as you live, work, and interact with your maids. Start with Trust & Fear, then learn about Hunger.
